text: Thanks, the screenshots show it. The bets under 'No +EV right now' are your old bets (odds 11 min old). The Best EV / Soonest / Stars buttons only appear above a fresh list, and that list is empty, so they vanish. The old list is also always in EV order. I'm fixing both: the sort buttons will show above the old bets as well and will sort them.
